name: Ghost
summary: Publish a blog and send a newsletter from your own server.
description: The MIT-licensed Ghost publishing platform, packaged from its upstream container image. Posts, images and the SQLite database live in Automaton's durable app directory. Newsletters stay off until the optional Mailgun settings are filled in.

application.description: Publish a blog and send a newsletter from your own server.

publicAccess.reason: Readers open your blog without an Automaton sign-in. Ghost has its own sign-in at /ghost/.

secrets.name: MAILGUN_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Mailgun API key for newsletters; leave empty to keep newsletters off

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional. Password for the SMTP server below

settings.name: GHOST_URL
settings.description: This app's full address, for example https://blog.example.com (no trailing slash). Ghost builds every link from it. Filled in with the app's own address; change it only after moving the blog to its own domain.

settings.name: MAILGUN_DOMAIN
settings.description: Optional. Mailgun sending domain, for example mg.example.com

settings.name: MAILGUN_REGION
settings.description: Optional. Mailgun region: EU or US

settings.name: MAIL_FROM
settings.description: Optional. Sender address for Ghost's own emails (sign-in, notifications)

settings.name: SMTP_HOST
settings.description: Optional. SMTP server for Ghost's own emails
